descriptionChirho: To solicit or entice someone toward sin or apostasy, typically with Satan or evil as the agent, including the substantival 'tempter' and passive 'be tempted'.
To put someone or something to the test in order to determine quality, faithfulness, or genuineness, whether by God testing humans or humans testing God or one another.
To make an effort or attempt to do something, without the nuance of moral enticement or quality assessment.
